title: FemTheme Solo #004 · 여 아워글래스 밤쉘·스칸디프로스트·뱀파이어 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright modern rooftop terrace with a pale deck floor, a waist-high glass railing, a standard door and a city skyline in the daylight haze, bright and backlit, shadows falling toward the camera, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, backlit by the low sun, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Swedish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, a cool, calm, faraway expression, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a lead round bell, a silver square-sided cowbell, a gold barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long gold chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop with a heavy rough lead a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre hanging at its end, and seven to ten heavily stacked gold rings. Extremely long stiletto nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a long black cape lined in red silk, fastened at her neck and hanging open down her back, leaving the front of her body bare, a tiny black satin micro-bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups on thin strings tied at the neck and back, fully covering her bust, and a minimal black satin micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme silver sculptural heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: a bright rim of sunlight outlining every figure, each material catching the backlight in glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
